items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: They are very dear friends of ours, especially the lady that Margaret lived with, Minnie

ctx.x: She played in church. Name is Mamie, that's all I know. I don't care what tune you played, the only thing she'd say is, what key, and play. They are very dear friends of ours, especially the lady that Margaret lived with, Minnie - you know Minnie. Minnie, that lived on the next floor? We played for a birthday party down there, and she played too. I think she played in a church practically every Sunday...

The way you're speaking about this friend here, did many of your friends, musician friends, get together in a friendship atmosphere like that, when you didn't get together just to play with each other but just to talk. To jive with each other -
